items.quote: Saudi Arabia Constructs Visionary Future: Billions in Riyals to Bring Sci-Fi Dreams to Life in Taif
items.statement: Saudi Arabia has announced plans for a "Science Fiction Space City" in Taif.

items.quote: The initial phase is backed by an investment of 5 billion Riyals ($1.3 billion)
